description: A shelf of higher rock with a good long view south to the wall and the gap in it. Up under the overhang, where the shadow sits all day, somebody has built a hide: netting over a frame, dressed with rock and dead scrub, and done well enough that you are past it before you see it. There is a lens in there catching the light. Nothing moves. Whoever is inside has watched you the whole way up and has decided to go on doing nothing, and there is a second set of ruts leading away north that are much fresher than the first.
name: The Rise
